# BRouter 1.7.10

NAV KURD uses the routing, map access, expression, codec and utility classes from the official `brouter-1.7.10-ro.jar`. The HTTP server and desktop entry points are excluded from the Android dependency. The signed APK carries the upstream car-fast, trekking and hiking-mountain profiles and their lookup table. The accompanying LICENSE applies to the software.

The SHA-256 of the upstream ZIP is `023fec3ba997758e8cd7ab9e1bae52e962af3f00b57683e3de86b84ffad01532`. The filtered JAR is `66245102dae4ebc68cf6ad637c7d07bb5c5fe68512e5b8ee69e123c871fb6c0e`. Original source and distribution are available in the [upstream release](https://github.com/abrensch/brouter/releases/tag/v1.7.10).

The pedestrian configuration disables SAC-rated mountain trails and marked-hiking-route preference. The four immutable road data segments cover the regional atlas and its surrounding roads. They contain data from © OpenStreetMap contributors, distributed under the Open Database License. Source URLs, byte lengths and SHA-256 digests are in `contracts/offline-routing.json`. The corresponding `data/road-graph-20261116` branch contains the snapshot publication workflow. [OpenStreetMap attribution and license](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)
